projects.title: Course Enrolment Records
bullets: Documented the schema and example queries for course enrolment records as a contribution to a team course project.
Wrote SQL queries joining and aggregating sample course enrolment records using SQLite.

projects.title: Study-Session Scheduler
bullets: Implemented a menu-driven study-session scheduler in Java using functions and collections, adding input checks.
Handled invalid entries and documented how study-session records are added, searched, and updated.
